content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Transactions ## slug: payments-dataload-historical-transactions-transactions ## seoTitle: Transactions ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ### Source: CSV Turn off all Transaction-related custom settings or check the Blackthorn Pay - Trigger Settings' custom setting {{variable.CS_PTTriggerSetting_DisableAll}} checkbox. :::(Info) (Double Check Your Mapping) Map your org's Charge Record Type ID value, not the word "Charge". This can be found by navigating to the object's Record Type listing, clicking **Charge**, and pulling the ID from the URL. ::: #### Required Fields * {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge" * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Completed" * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Captured" * {{variable.Field_Transaction_NonGateway}} = "True" #### Suggested Fields * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Account}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Contact}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_ProcessedDat}} (map a date field if a date/time field isn't available) #### Suggested Fields if Records Originated from a Stripe Account * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentGatew}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactioID}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CustomerID}} Upon completion, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Source}} field on each {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will be set to "Sync".
